# Security policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

## Reporting privately

Do not open public issues for credentials, repository leaks, image resemblance complaints, access control bypasses, or privacy-sensitive matters.

Email **i.am@dangkhoa.dev** with the affected component, revision, reproducible steps and impact. Avoid including actual secrets, biometric data or identity documents.

## Boundaries

- The gallery is a static preview only; its contact form constructs a mail-client draft, **not** an acknowledged server-side report.
- GitHub contains code and samples, not the accepted 935 PNGs or GPU weights.
- Never expose access tokens, account credentials, or access-controlled storage through unprotected public endpoints or tunnels.
- Acknowledgements, fixes and disclosure are coordinated as availability permits; there is no guaranteed response SLA.
- Software license MIT does not change independent dataset/model restrictions.

For normal questions see [Support](SUPPORT.md).
